positions.name: BranchLibraryWeekdayOperatingHoursAndStaffing
positions.frame: how should branch library weekday operating hours be adjusted to accommodate commuter book return patterns while maintaining flat staffing levels?
positions.why: Moira and Teo describe a balanced schedule shift on Tuesdays and Thursdays: advancing opening hours to capture morning commuter returns while closing an hour early to maintain overall staffing equilibrium.
